newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA - SEVEN OFFERS RECEIVED FOR TELECOM TENDER.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA - SEVEN OFFERS RECEIVED FOR TELECOM TENDER.

text.p: Lithuania's European affairs ministry said on Thursday that it had received seven offers to participate in the tender to advise the country's government on the privatisation of Lithuanian Telecom.

"Seven technical and financial offers for a tender to become the government's lead advisor on telecom privatisation were received," Alfredas Ramanauskas, deputy director of the ministry's privatisation department, told Reuters.
The tender deadline expired on Wednesday.

Ramanauskas said that the ministry received offers from Creditanstalt Invesment Bank, Union Bank of Switzerland, Banque Paribas and Cliford Chance, Flemings and Hansa Investments, and Deutche Morgan Grenfell with Nomura International.
The other bidders were N.M. Rothschild & Sons Ltd and Squire, Sanders and Dempsey and Daiwa Institute of Research.
"Today the tender commission will start consideration of the offers and we expect it will last no later than the middle of next week," Ramanauskas said.
"In case there are some equally good offers the commission might ask for additional presentation from the participants," Ramanauskas added.
The 100 percent state-run telephone company is one of 13 key infrustructure enterprises slated for privatisation.
The government said earlier it expected to start the actual privatisation of the firm early in 1998.
